sentences.en: I think overall, there is an attitude that that's just the price of doing business with a creative genius.
sentences.zh: 我认为总的来说，有一种态度认为这就是与天才创作者做生意的代价。

sentences.en: So in spite of these early red flags, things proceed.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管有这些早期的危险信号，事情还是继续进行了。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: They just jump into the work together.
sentences.zh: 他们只是投入到一起工作中。

sentences.en: And listen, the Adidas employees learned that Kanye West operates unlike anybody else they've ever worked with.
sentences.zh: 而且听着，阿迪达斯的员工了解到，坎耶·韦斯特的工作方式与他们曾经共事过的任何人都不一样。

sentences.en: He is brimming with ideas and can be enthusiastic to the point of chaos.
sentences.zh: 他点子多得冒泡，热情起来甚至会让人觉得有些混乱。

sentences.en: And those people who work with him say he was also so obsessed with detail that it could be hard to get anything done.
sentences.zh: 与他共事的人说，他同时也对细节有着近乎偏执的追求，以至于很难把事情推进下去。

sentences.en: But eventually, by the beginning of 2015, they have finalized the first Yeezy sneakers, among them the Yeezy Boost 350.
sentences.zh: 但最终，到2015年初，他们敲定了第一批Yeezy运动鞋，其中就包括Yeezy Boost 350。

sentences.en: And it's this sleek sneaker that was inspired by Nike's Roshi Run, which was the shoe that had come out at the time.
sentences.zh: 这款线条流畅的运动鞋灵感源自当时刚推出的耐克Roshi Run。

sentences.en: It was nicknamed, actually, the Roshi Killer inside Adidas.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它在阿迪达斯内部被戏称为“Roshi杀手”。

sentences.en: And it had, like, a flat front, not the standard kind of rolled toe that you see on a lot of running shoes.
sentences.zh: 它的鞋头是平的，不像很多跑鞋那样采用常见的圆头设计。

sentences.en: It was covered with this pattern fabric.
sentences.zh: 鞋面覆盖着这种花纹面料。

sentences.en: And, you know, it wasn't well-suited for running or sports, but it went perfectly with the kind of athleisure fashion that was coming into style.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它并不适合跑步或运动，但却完美契合了当时正流行的运动休闲风。

sentences.en: As artists in this world, we can do whatever we want.
sentences.zh: 作为这个世界的艺术家，我们可以随心所欲。

sentences.en: And the plan is to debut this first season of Yeezy at New York Fashion Week.
sentences.zh: 计划是在纽约时装周上首次发布Yeezy系列。

sentences.en: And the moment finally arrives.
sentences.zh: 那一刻终于到来了。

sentences.en: The models come out in all this apparel and these new shoes.
sentences.zh: 模特们穿着各种服装和这些新鞋走上台。

sentences.en: You know, Kanye's in the front of the group in a very sort of just a black hooded sweatshirt and black pants.
sentences.zh: 坎耶走在队伍最前面，穿着一件简单的黑色连帽衫和黑色长裤。

sentences.en: And on his feet are one of the new pairs of Yeezys.
sentences.zh: 脚上穿着一双新款Yeezy。

sentences.en: And the front row is packed with, like, a who's who of the most famous in the world.
sentences.zh: 前排坐满了世界上最出名的大人物。

sentences.en: Can I just ask what you thought of the show, Beyonce?
sentences.zh: 碧昂丝，能问问你对这场秀的看法吗？

sentences.en: I thought it was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很美。

sentences.en: Very innovative.
sentences.zh: 非常有创意。

sentences.en: I love how...
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这种……

sentences.en: There's Beyoncé, Jay-Z, there's Rihanna, there's a cluster of Kardashians.
sentences.zh: 碧昂丝、Jay-Z、蕾哈娜都在，还有一群卡戴珊家族的人。

sentences.en: It's exactly what Adidas and Kanye had hoped for.
sentences.zh: 这正是阿迪达斯和坎耶所期待的。

sentences.en: I'm not even focused on probleMs. That's how I change them.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不去关注问题所在，这就是我改变它们的方式。

sentences.en: We just focus on beauty, fabric, proportion, and trying to get the price where the kids can get a hold of it.
sentences.zh: 我们只专注于美感、面料、比例，并努力把价格控制在孩子们能买得起的范围内。

sentences.en: And then, you know, released in limited runs over the next few months, the shoes sold out in hours, like crashed servers.
sentences.zh: 随后，在接下来的几个月里，这些鞋子限量发售，几小时内就被抢购一空，甚至导致服务器崩溃。

sentences.en: We want to see the shoes.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看鞋子。

sentences.en: Drum roll, please.
sentences.zh: 请敲鼓助兴。

sentences.zh: 它们吸引了鞋迷和时尚达人。

sentences.en: And even sports figures who had endorsement deals with rival companies.
sentences.zh: 甚至连那些与竞争对手公司签有代言协议的体育明星们。

sentences.en: Are buying these.

sentences.en: Yeah, it was tremendously, tremendously successful.

sentences.en: So this Kanye West Adidas deal is working out very nicely.
sentences.zh: 所以，坎耶·韦斯特与阿迪达斯的这笔交易进行得非常顺利。

sentences.en: I'm curious, Megan, did your reporting uncover any other additional troubling behaviors by Kanye West within this collaboration he was having with the company?
sentences.zh: 梅根，我很好奇，你的报道是否揭露了坎耶·韦斯特在与公司合作期间的其他令人不安的行为？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: My reporting found that, in fact, this was a very tumultuous time inside this partnership behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 我的报道发现，事实上，在幕后，这段合作关系经历了一段非常动荡的时期。

sentences.en: Kanye West, actually, in preparing as they were running up against the deadline for the launch of Yeezy Season 1 at New York Fashion Week,
sentences.zh: 坎耶·韦斯特在为纽约时装周Yeezy第一季发布会赶工期时，

sentences.en: erupted in anger at the staff and used extremely sexually explicit offensive language.
sentences.zh: 对员工大发雷霆，并使用了极其露骨且具有冒犯性的性语言。

sentences.en: And it was so bad that several members of the team actually complained to higher-ups at Adidas about it.
sentences.zh: 情况非常糟糕，以至于团队中的几名成员甚至向阿迪达斯的高层投诉了此事。

sentences.en: And those type of explosions in anger would prove to be quite common.
sentences.zh: 而这类爆发性的愤怒在后来变得相当普遍。

sentences.en: But none of this behavior and not even the complaints slows things down.
sentences.zh: 但这些行为，甚至包括那些投诉，都没有让事情慢下来。

sentences.en: The attention quickly shifts back to the success of these sneakers.
sentences.zh: 人们的注意力很快又回到了这些运动鞋的成功上。

sentences.en: In fact, you know, each year, everybody in the industry gathers for what is known as basically the shoe Oscars.
sentences.zh: 事实上，每年业内所有人都会聚集在一起，参加被称为“鞋界奥斯卡”的颁奖礼。

sentences.en: And that year...
sentences.zh: 而那一年……

sentences.en: We're honored to present him the 2015 Footwear News Shoe of the Year Award for the Adidas Yeezy Boots.
sentences.zh: 我们很荣幸为他颁发2015年《鞋类新闻》年度最佳鞋履奖，以表彰阿迪达斯Yeezy Boost。

sentences.en: The 350 won Shoe of the Year.
sentences.zh: 350系列赢得了年度最佳鞋履奖。

sentences.en: Basically, the Oscar for Best New Shoe.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是最佳新鞋奥斯卡奖。

sentences.en: Why would she make a cause of...
sentences.zh: 她为什么要制造一个……

sentences.en: And a beaming Kanye takes to the stage with three Adidas executives behind him.
sentences.zh: 满面春风的坎耶带着三位阿迪达斯高管走上舞台。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: So it's cool to be up here with the three people that I've screamed at the most in the past year.
sentences.zh: 能和过去一年里我吼得最多的人站在这里，感觉真酷。

sentences.en: And it's actually kind of telling because the first thing that Kanye says is, it's nice to be up here with three of the people that I've yelled at the most in the last year.
sentences.zh: 这其实挺耐人寻味的，因为坎耶说的第一句话就是：“能和过去一年里我吼得最多的人站在这里，感觉真好。”

sentences.en: But, you know, his tone shifting, he later says quite seriously, there was one executive, John Wexler, who had helped make the deal happen.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，他的语气变了，后来他非常严肃地说，有一位高管约翰·韦克斯勒，他促成了这笔交易。

sentences.en: I have to point out, because then I have to talk about how John basically saved my life.
sentences.zh: 我必须提一下，因为我得说说约翰是如何拯救了我的生命。

sentences.en: John Wexler, this guy...
sentences.zh: 约翰·韦克斯勒，这家伙……

sentences.en: And Kanye says in what appears to be like a very serious tone, you know, John basically saved my life.
sentences.zh: 坎耶用一种看起来非常严肃的语气说：“你知道，约翰基本上救了我的命。”

sentences.en: They allowed me to be me.
sentences.zh: 他们让我做回自己。

sentences.en: They allowed me to express myself.
sentences.zh: 他们让我表达自我。

sentences.en: But it's very serious.
sentences.zh: 但这非常严肃。

sentences.en: We're here to make amazing product that we love, that also sells, that makes money.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里是为了制造我们热爱的、能卖出去、能赚钱的优质产品。

sentences.en: So on a personal level, this is very meaningful to Kanye.
sentences.zh: 所以从个人层面来说，这对坎耶意义重大。

sentences.en: This person who, as you said earlier, had wanted so very much to be taken seriously in the fashion world.
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才所说，这个一直非常渴望在时尚界被认真对待的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: And the success is also very meaningful to Adidas.
sentences.zh: 这种成功对阿迪达斯也意义重大。

sentences.en: I mean, they've been in business now for less than two years.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们合作还不到两年。

sentences.en: And already the company is thinking, how can we take this deal even farther?
sentences.zh: 公司就已经在考虑：我们该如何把这笔交易推向更远？

sentences.en: How can we go all in on Kanye West?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何全力押注坎耶·韦斯特？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是维娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责创作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏吧。

sentences.en: So what does going all in with Kanye West look like for Adidas?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于阿迪达斯来说，全力押注坎耶·韦斯特意味着什么？

sentences.en: So it means we're now in 2016.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们现在进入了2016年。

sentences.en: And even though the first contract is not up for renewal yet, they're pouncing on the chance to do a new contract, a new deal.
sentences.zh: 尽管第一份合同还没到续约期，但他们抓住了机会签署了一份新合同，达成了一笔新交易。

sentences.en: To make it even longer.
sentences.zh: 让合作期限更长。

sentences.en: To make it longer, to set themselves up to make even more money.
sentences.zh: 让它更长，好让自己赚更多的钱。

sentences.en: But significantly, this time around, the company wants to insert a mechanism into the deal that's going to allow the company to protect itself.
sentences.zh: 但重要的是，这一次，公司希望在协议中加入一种机制，让公司能够保护自己。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Adidas has seen some very problematic behavior behind the scenes, certainly enough to make them want to protect themselves.
sentences.zh: 阿迪达斯在幕后看到了一些非常成问题的行为，足以让他们想要自我保护。

sentences.en: So what are they discussing exactly?
sentences.zh: 那么他们具体在讨论什么？

sentences.en: How are they envisioning doing that?
sentences.zh: 他们打算如何实现这一点？

sentences.en: So Adidas is pushing for something known as a morals clause to go into the contract that would basically outline the situations under which it could terminate the deal with Kanye.
sentences.zh: 阿迪达斯正在推动在合同中加入所谓的“道德条款”，基本上就是列出在什么情况下可以终止与坎耶的合作。

sentences.en: Basically spelling out certain behaviors, certain lines that if Kanye crosses them, it can have the legal right to say, okay, this deal is over.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是明确规定某些行为，划定某些底线，如果坎耶越界，公司就有法律权利说：好吧，交易结束了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The kind of moral boundaries under which things would end.
sentences.zh: 结束合作的道德界限。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And talking to people, executives who have worked at big companies that do these kind of deals, they have stressed that they're really important because, you know, yes,
sentences.zh: 与那些在大公司处理过此类交易的高管交谈时，他们强调这些条款非常重要，因为，你知道，是的，

sentences.en: the company has to serve its bottom line and enter into deals that are going to be lucrative, but it also has to protect its reputation.
sentences.zh: 公司必须服务于底线，达成有利可图的交易，但它也必须保护自己的声誉。

sentences.en: And if it's getting into business with somebody who has problematic behavior, especially perspectives or attitudes that could be easily discoverable,
sentences.zh: 如果它与一个有成问题行为的人做生意，尤其是那些容易被发现的观点或态度，

sentences.en: then the company runs the risk of looking complicit when that all spills into public view.
sentences.zh: 那么当这一切公之于众时，公司就会面临被视为同谋的风险。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Basically, whether or not it's explicit, endorsing it.
sentences.zh: 基本上，无论是否明确，都在为其背书。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And so after months of negotiations,
sentences.zh: 经过几个月的谈判，

sentences.en: Adidas and Kanye West finally reach a deal and Kanye actually agrees to the morals clause and it has some pretty specific and strident terms for termination, a felony conviction,
sentences.zh: 阿迪达斯和坎耶·韦斯特终于达成协议，坎耶实际上同意了道德条款，其中包含了一些非常具体且严厉的终止条款：重罪定罪、

sentences.en: bankruptcy, 30 consecutive days of mental health or substance abuse treatment or anything that brings disrepute, contempt, scandal to him or tarnishes Adidas.
sentences.zh: 破产、连续30天接受心理健康或药物滥用治疗，或任何导致他本人名誉扫地、受辱、丑闻，或损害阿迪达斯形象的行为。

sentences.en: Pretty broad language, especially given some of the behavior that Kanye West displays.
sentences.zh: 考虑到坎耶·韦斯特表现出的一些行为，这些措辞相当宽泛。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: But it's also important to know that while Adidas is getting this moral clause, Kanye West is also getting a lot in this contract as well.
sentences.zh: 但同样重要的是要知道，虽然阿迪达斯获得了这个道德条款，但坎耶·韦斯特在这份合同中也得到了很多。

sentences.en: It's loaded with financial incentives for him.
sentences.zh: 它充满了对他个人的经济激励。

sentences.en: You know, during the negotiations, Adidas was predicting that Yeezy sales would grow to $1 billion a year by 2021.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在谈判期间，阿迪达斯预测到2021年Yeezy的销售额将增长到每年10亿美元。

sentences.en: And under this deal, he will continue to get a 15% royalty of net sales.
sentences.zh: 根据这份协议，他将继续获得净销售额15%的特许权使用费。

sentences.en: I just want to pause because that is a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 我想暂停一下，因为那是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: 15% of a billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 10亿美元的15%。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And on top of that, he will also get $15 million up front, along with millions of dollars in company stock each year.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，他还能预先获得1500万美元，以及每年价值数百万美元的公司股票。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So this is what going all in with Kanye West looks like.
sentences.zh: 这就是全力押注坎耶·韦斯特的样子。

sentences.en: For Adidas, it means getting a morals clause from their partner.
sentences.zh: 对阿迪达斯来说，这意味着从合作伙伴那里获得了一份道德条款。

sentences.en: For Kanye, it means a boatload of money.
sentences.zh: 对坎耶来说，这意味着一大笔钱。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我忘了提合同中最重要的一部分是，如果他们达到一定的财务目标，合作可以延长整整十年。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And, you know, as Kanye said when he signed the new contract in May of 2016, the partnership was now a marriage.
sentences.zh: 而且，正如坎耶在2016年5月签署新合同时所说，这种伙伴关系现在是一场婚姻。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.zh: 那么，一旦阿迪达斯和坎耶成为“新婚夫妇”，会发生什么？

sentences.en: A lot happens.
sentences.zh: 发生了很多事。

sentences.zh: 就在签署那份合同几个月后，他进行了几年来首次巡演。

sentences.en: And he was, at first, wowing audiences with this floating stage.
sentences.zh: 起初，他用这个悬浮舞台让观众惊叹不已。

sentences.en: But then his shows take this really unexpected turn.
sentences.zh: 但随后他的演出出现了非常出人意料的转折。

sentences.en: You ain't got an iPhone.
sentences.zh: 你没有iPhone。

sentences.en: Don't put it up.
sentences.zh: 别举起来。

sentences.zh: 他在萨克拉门托演出，唱了几首歌后，

sentences.en: And he just stops and launches into this 17-minute tirade.
sentences.zh: 他突然停下来，开始了一场长达17分钟的咆哮。

sentences.en: This is the way of thinking to make—
sentences.zh: 这就是那种思维方式，让——

sentences.en: He's praising President-elect Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他在赞美当选总统唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: You was lied to my—
sentences.zh: 你被骗了，我的——

sentences.en: He is blasting the tech and media and music industries.
sentences.zh: 他在抨击科技、媒体和音乐行业。

sentences.en: Beyonce, I was hurt.
sentences.zh: 碧昂丝，我受伤了。

sentences.en: He is bad-mouthing Beyonce.

sentences.zh: 他最终参加了《Drink Champs》播客，坚持他所说的一切，甚至更进一步。

sentences.en: The thing about it, me and Adidas, it's like, I could literally say anti-Semitic shit and they can't drop me.
sentences.zh: 关于这件事，我和阿迪达斯，就像是，我可以字面上说反犹太的狗屁话，他们也不能开除我。

sentences.en: He says in this interview, I can say anti-Semitic stuff and Adidas can't drop me.
sentences.zh: 他在这次采访中说，我可以发表反犹太言论，阿迪达斯不能开除我。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I could say anti-Semitic things and Adidas can't drop me.
sentences.zh: 我可以发表反犹太言论，阿迪达斯不能开除我。

sentences.en: Now what?
sentences.zh: 现在怎么样？

sentences.en: But he's basically saying in this marriage, I hold so many of the cards that I can make Adidas stay with me.
sentences.zh: 但他基本上是在说，在这段婚姻中，我掌握了太多的筹码，我可以让阿迪达斯留在我身边。

sentences.en: I can kind of make them complicit.
sentences.zh: 我可以让他们成为共犯。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And of course, in the moment, that sounds like shocking to listeners of that interview.
sentences.zh: 当然，在那一刻，这对采访的听众来说听起来很令人震惊。

sentences.en: But now, having reported behind the scenes, you can get a sense of how he could actually say that.
sentences.zh: 但现在，在报道了幕后情况后，你可以感觉到他为什么真的能说出那样的话。

sentences.en: And why it might be true.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么这可能是真的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: At least from his perspective and his experience over those many years of the partnership.
sentences.zh: 至少从他的角度以及他在多年合作中的经历来看是这样。

sentences.en: But, you know, at this point, he is coming under even more broad and intense attack and criticism.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，在这一点上，他正受到更广泛、更强烈的攻击和批评。

sentences.en: Politicians, Jewish leaders, fellow entertainers,
sentences.zh: 政客、犹太领袖、同行艺人，

sentences.en: people like leaders in Hollywood are denouncing his behavior and saying that it's dangerous and is going to inspire others to embrace bigotry.
sentences.zh: 像好莱坞领袖这样的人都在谴责他的行为，并称其危险，会激励其他人拥抱偏见。

sentences.en: And are really exerting pressure on Adidas to cut ties.
sentences.zh: 并且真的在向阿迪达斯施压，要求其断绝关系。

sentences.en: And so, just days after that Drink Champs interview, in which he was basically taunting Adidas to try to cut ties with him, the company does just that.
sentences.zh: 所以，在那次《Drink Champs》采访几天后，他在采访中基本上是在嘲讽阿迪达斯试图与他断绝关系，公司确实这样做了。

sentences.en: They tell Kanye that he has violated the terms of their contract and that they have the legal right to now end it.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉坎耶，他违反了合同条款，他们现在有法律权利终止合同。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Well, given just how important this partnership has been to both sides, it's floating Kanye.
sentences.zh: 好吧，考虑到这种合作对双方都如此重要，这对坎耶来说是毁灭性的。

sentences.en: It's the bulk of his money, you've told us.
sentences.zh: 你告诉我们，这是他大部分的收入来源。

sentences.en: And for Adidas, it's been their revival.
sentences.zh: 而对于阿迪达斯来说，这是他们的复兴。

sentences.en: What happens once this deal is off?
sentences.zh: 一旦这笔交易结束，会发生什么？

sentences.en: So, Adidas immediately stopped selling Yeezys.
sentences.zh: 所以，阿迪达斯立即停止了Yeezy的销售。

sentences.en: And both parties take a huge hit.
sentences.zh: 双方都遭受了沉重打击。

sentences.en: The company projected its first annual loss in decades, and Kanye West's net worth plummets.
sentences.zh: 该公司预计将出现几十年来首次年度亏损，而坎耶·韦斯特的净资产也大幅缩水。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And so, the cost of this over-reliance, this mutual dependence that had become so great in this moment is very clearly laid bare.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种过度依赖的代价，这种在这一刻变得如此巨大的相互依存关系，被非常清晰地暴露了出来。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And it's not over.
sentences.zh: 而且这还没结束。

sentences.en: How is it not over?
sentences.zh: 怎么会没结束呢？

sentences.en: I mean, it's supposed to be, Adidas says, over.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，阿迪达斯说这应该已经结束了。

sentences.en: So, even as they're publicly attacking each other, Kanye West and Adidas continue to have a shared intereSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使他们公开互相攻击，坎耶·韦斯特和阿迪达斯仍然有着共同的利益。

sentences.en: And that is in the $1.3 billion of Yeezy inventory that are in warehouses around the world.
sentences.zh: 那就是存放在世界各地仓库中价值13亿美元的Yeezy库存。

sentences.en: And that had been basically just shelved after the agreement came to an end.
sentences.zh: 在协议终止后，这些库存基本上就被搁置了。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 真令人着迷。

sentences.en: And by May of last year, Adidas now has a new CEO, and he comes out and announces that they're going to actually release all of that inventory for sale.
sentences.zh: 到了去年五月，阿迪达斯换了新任首席执行官，他出来宣布他们实际上要将所有这些库存投放市场销售。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: Even as they're divorcing, they're still relying on each other.
sentences.zh: 即使在分道扬镳时，他们依然相互依赖。

sentences.en: Yeah, they're not missing an opportunity to make at least one more round of serious money.
sentences.zh: 没错，他们没有错过再大赚一笔的机会。

sentences.en: And the cut of those sales would go to the Anti-Defamation League and a group founded by George Floyd's family.
sentences.zh: 这些销售额的一部分将捐给反诽谤联盟和一个由乔治·弗洛伊德家人创立的组织。

sentences.en: But most of the money is going to Adidas, and under the contract, Kanye West is still entitled to royalties of those sales.
sentences.zh: 但大部分钱还是归阿迪达斯所有，而且根据合同，坎耶·韦斯特仍有权从这些销售中获得版税。

sentences.en: And so, the shoes ended up taking in about $437 million in sales through June, just these first waves.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些鞋子在六月份之前通过几波销售，最终带来了约4.37亿美元的收入。

sentences.en: And they're not done with those sales.
sentences.zh: 而且他们的销售还没有结束。

sentences.en: And so, with this influx of Yeezy money, the company has been able to improve its financial forecast for the year, and Kanye West has reappeared.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着这笔Yeezy资金的流入，该公司得以改善了今年的财务预测，而坎耶·韦斯特也重新露面了。

sentences.en: You know, he performed on stage for the first time over the summer, and music from what is rumored to be a comeback album has leaked online.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他在夏天首次登台表演，据传是复出专辑的音乐也在网上泄露了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, in the end, despite everything he did, he's still profiting from this partnership.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，尽管他做了所有那些事，他仍然在从这段合作关系中获利。

sentences.en: And so, as Adidas, even as it can go out in the world and say, we canceled this deal.
sentences.zh: 所以，阿迪达斯即使可以在世界上公开宣称，我们取消了这笔交易。

sentences.en: We're done with it.
sentences.zh: 我们不再参与了。

sentences.en: We're not affiliated with him anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们和他再也没有任何关联了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think what we were also able to see was that consumers, by and large, were not deterred by what happened last fall.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们还能看到的是，消费者大体上并没有被去年秋天发生的事情所吓退。

sentences.en: And the way that these shoes started to sell out again so quickly also showed that many people just didn't care about Kanye West's behavior.
sentences.zh: 这些鞋子再次如此迅速地售罄，也表明许多人根本不在乎坎耶·韦斯特的行为。

sentences.en: And there even starts to be some speculation that Adidas and Kanye West may actually go into another deal again.
sentences.zh: 甚至开始有一些猜测认为，阿迪达斯和坎耶·韦斯特实际上可能会再次达成另一项协议。

sentences.en: But, you know, when I reached out to Adidas to present what I had found through my reporting as we prepared to publish our story,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，当我联系阿迪达斯，想要展示我在准备报道故事时所发现的情况时，

sentences.en: they provided me with a statement saying that Adidas has no tolerance for hate speech and offensive behavior, which is why the company terminated the Adidas Yeezy partnership.
sentences.zh: 他们提供了一份声明，称阿迪达斯对仇恨言论和冒犯性行为零容忍，这就是公司终止阿迪达斯与Yeezy合作关系的原因。

sentences.en: The company, you know, turned down interview requests and, citing confidentiality rules,
sentences.zh: 公司拒绝了采访请求，并以保密规则为由，

sentences.en: declined to comment on financial aspects of the collaboration and its relationship with Kanye WeSt.
sentences.zh: 拒绝就合作的财务方面及其与坎耶·韦斯特的关系发表评论。

sentences.en: And Kanye West declined interview requests and did not respond to written questions or provide comments.
sentences.zh: 而坎耶·韦斯特拒绝了采访请求，也没有回复书面问题或提供评论。

sentences.en: Megan, zooming way out for a second, there seem to be two ways to think about the story you have just told us.
sentences.zh: 梅根，把镜头拉远一点，你刚才讲的这个故事似乎有两种解读方式。

sentences.en: On one level, the story you found here about Adidas and Kanye is really the story, it seems, of a company doing whatever it had to do to appease a troubled partner.
sentences.zh: 从一个层面来看，你在这里发现的关于阿迪达斯和坎耶的故事，似乎确实是一个公司为了安抚一个麻烦不断的合作伙伴而不惜一切代价的故事。

sentences.en: Instead of holding Kanye accountable for his behaviors, Adidas just kept throwing more and more money at him, even as the things he was saying were getting more and more offensive.
sentences.zh: 阿迪达斯不仅没有让坎耶为自己的行为负责，反而不断地向他投入更多的钱，即使他所说的话变得越来越具有冒犯性。

sentences.en: And the company did not seem all that interested in blunting the impact on the people that Kanye was offending, either inside or outside of the company.
sentences.zh: 而且该公司似乎对减轻坎耶冒犯他人（无论是公司内部还是外部）所带来的影响也不太感兴趣。

sentences.en: But on another level, it seems to be the story of a company getting exactly what it bargained for, right?
sentences.zh: 但从另一个层面来看，这似乎是一个公司得到了它所期望的一切的故事，对吧？

sentences.en: A provocative celebrity, this mad genius who was going to garner a ton of attention, some good, some bad, that was going to turn into profit.
sentences.zh: 一个挑衅性的名人，这个疯狂的天才，他会吸引大量的关注，有好有坏，而这些关注最终会转化为利润。

sentences.en: And that's what happened.
sentences.zh: 事实也确实如此。

sentences.en: Adidas got the attention.
sentences.zh: 阿迪达斯获得了关注。

sentences.en: It got the profit.
sentences.zh: 它获得了利润。

sentences.en: So what are we supposed to make of all that?
sentences.zh: 那么我们该如何看待这一切呢？

sentences.en: Well, I think that you're right, that this really is a classic tale of a company that made this fraught bargain in pursuit of celebrity and profit.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为你是对的，这确实是一个经典的故事，讲述了一家公司为了追求名气和利润而做出了这种令人不安的交易。

sentences.en: And Adidas tapped into that and capitalized on that.
sentences.zh: 阿迪达斯利用了这一点并从中获利。

sentences.en: This Yeezy collaboration made more money and became more culturally influential than, I think, either party.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这次Yeezy合作所赚的钱和在文化上的影响力，超出了双方的预期。

sentences.en: Certainly Adidas imagined when they first started the relationship.
sentences.zh: 当然，阿迪达斯在刚开始这段关系时是这样设想的。

sentences.en: And I remember talking to a source who had worked at Adidas and had been closely involved in the collaboration who described it like a company becoming hooked on a bad drug.
sentences.zh: 我记得曾与一位曾在阿迪达斯工作并密切参与此次合作的消息人士交谈，他将其描述为一家公司对一种坏药上瘾。

sentences.en: And they just got deeper and deeper and more and more hooked and didn't know how to break away.
sentences.zh: 他们越陷越深，瘾越来越大，却不知道如何摆脱。

sentences.en: And so by the time this relationship came to an end, by the time Adidas was backed into a corner and had to end it, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以当这段关系结束时，当阿迪达斯被逼到墙角不得不结束它时，你知道，

sentences.en: you were able to see how completely dependent they had become.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出他们已经变得多么彻底地依赖它了。

sentences.en: On that drug that was Kanye WeSt.
sentences.zh: 依赖那个叫坎耶·韦斯特的毒药。

sentences.en: On that drug that was Kanye WeSt.
sentences.zh: 依赖那个叫坎耶·韦斯特的毒药。

sentences.en: And by that point, it was too late.
sentences.zh: 而到了那个时候，已经太晚了。

sentences.en: They had become overly dependent on him.
sentences.zh: 他们已经对他产生了过度依赖。

sentences.en: So, you know, they're now scrambling to recover.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他们现在正忙于恢复。

sentences.en: And it's not clear to what extent they'll be able to recover.
sentences.zh: 而且目前还不清楚他们能在多大程度上恢复。

sentences.en: There's only one Kanye WeSt.
sentences.zh: 坎耶·韦斯特只有一个。

sentences.en: And you can't really replicate what the collaboration with him brought to Adidas.
sentences.zh: 你无法真正复制与他合作给阿迪达斯带来的东西。

sentences.en: But you also can't really calculate the damage that the collaboration did to Adidas in the process.
sentences.zh: 但你也无法真正计算出在此过程中，这种合作对阿迪达斯造成的损害。

sentences.en: Well, Megan, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，梅根，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, a few days after the publication of Megan's investigation, the CEO of Adidas, Bjorn Goulden,
sentences.zh: 周三，在梅根的调查报道发表几天后，阿迪达斯首席执行官比约恩·古尔登，

sentences.en: raised the possibility that the company may never release the remaining stock of unsold Yeezy shoes, a decision that he said could cost Adidas about $320 million.
sentences.zh: 提出了公司可能永远不会发布剩余未售出Yeezy鞋库存的可能性，他说这一决定可能会让阿迪达斯损失约3.2亿美元。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 而如果曼钦不在西弗吉尼亚州的选票上，
